facts.value: no later than the next established payday
facts.summary: Maine: when an employee is fired or laid off, final wages are due no later than the next established payday.
facts.evidence_quote: An employee leaving employment must be paid in full no later than the employee's next established payday.

facts.value: no later than the next established payday
facts.summary: Maine: when an employee is quits or resigns, final wages are due no later than the next established payday.
facts.evidence_quote: An employee leaving employment must be paid in full no later than the employee's next established payday.

facts.applies_to: As listed by U.S. DOL, page updated November 5, 2026
facts.summary: Maine basic state minimum wage listed by U.S. DOL: $15.10.
facts.evidence_quote: Basic Minimum Rate (per hour): $15.10 Premium Pay After Designated Hours 1 : Weekly - 40 If the highest federal minimum wage is increased in excess of the State minimum wage in effect, then the State minimum wage will increase to the same amount, effective on the same date as the increase in the federal minimum wage. The minimum wage is adjusted annually based on a set formula.
facts.source_title: State Minimum Wage Laws (U.S. DOL Wage and Hour Division)
facts.source_publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division
facts.notes: Local (city or county) minimum wages are not included. Scheduled January 1, 2027 increases are not reflected until DOL updates the page.

facts.summary: Maine independent contractor reporting required? (per OCSE): Yes

facts.notes: Text as entered by the state in the OCSE guide.

facts.summary: Maine new hire reporting timeframe (per OCSE): Within 7 days of hire date
facts.evidence_quote: Reporting Timeframe: Within 7 days of hire date
facts.source_title: State New Hire Reporting, State Contact and Program Information (HHS OCSE Intergovernmental Reference Guide)
facts.source_publisher: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Office of Child Support Services
facts.notes: Federal floor is 20 days; states may set shorter deadlines. Text as entered by the state in the OCSE guide.

facts.summary: Maine: frequencies marked in the U.S. DOL State Payday Requirements table: Semi-monthly (note 8).
facts.source_title: State Payday Requirements (U.S. DOL Wage and Hour Division)
facts.source_publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division
facts.notes: Note 8: Maine. Payment is due at regular intervals not to exceed 16 days. | DOL table last revised 2023-01-01; DOL says to consult the state labor office for official information. Confirm against current state law before relying on it.

facts.summary: Maine is not listed with a final 2026 FUTA credit reduction, so the effective FUTA rate is 0.6% on the first $7,000 per employee (if the full 5.4% state credit applies).
facts.evidence_quote: State not listed in the Final 2026 FUTA Credit Reductions table.
facts.source_title: Final 2026 Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) Credit Reductions (updated November 10, 2026)
facts.source_publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration
